title: Synthetic Relational Database Testbed for Rank Collapse & RAMA Validation
summary: Demo notebook for the Synthetic Relational Database Testbed that generates parent-child hierarchical data across 12 conditions (4 cardinality regimes x 3 projection ranks). The notebook loads a 60-example mini dataset covering all 12 conditions, then regenerates the full 3,750-example dataset using the original parameters (5.8s generation time). Runs all 7 validation checks (rank correlation, proxy accuracy, target-variance dependency, classification balance, condition coverage, split ratios, NaN/Inf) - all pass. Includes 4-panel visualization of effective rank vs projection rank, SVD vs proxy correlation, regression target vs variance, and classification balance. Total runtime ~2m11s including package installation.
